title: 第1013章 力战古神第1012章 夫妻同心
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
战云密布的灰暗幽空神光闪烁，一袭银光闪闪神帅战甲拉满神战防御的干精瘦猴八西胡琵琶神将，
发现他因对方那个美若天仙轻纱绿衣女神到来被无视了。
这是对它古神神将赤裸裸的藐视【这个古神不算太古，是瑾天帝时期古神，也就是数百万年前古神。他是真正远古琵琶古神的分身后裔】
见两个下界低贱物种【琵琶神将嫉妒英俊美丽】在神战生死关头却当着他谈笑风生，完全没有把它这个高高在上天神放在眼里，
琵琶神将急火攻心先下手为强，抄起它的琵琶琴便拨动琴弦，弹出最强万古诅咒杀伐最毒收魂噬魄音波；“琵琶金刚镇三界，死！”
琵琶古神一出手，就知乱弹琴。来自洪荒时期的枇杷树成精后裔不是盖的，音波带着万古诅咒杀伐宛如万千魂杀飞箭音浪霎那间席卷幽暗天空。
能封为逆神天庭天兵神将岂会是庸庸碌碌之辈？超神法力一刹那便让帝国神兵勇士无法抵挡。而琵琶神将的诅咒杀伐主要针对帝子云，正所谓擒贼先擒王。
呼延娜娜公主即使展开神光神域，也被琵琶神将万古诅咒音波攻透，只感觉神魂不稳，万蚁噬心。神域之内无敌也只是相对而言，一旦对方阶位神通仙术超过太多，同样形同虚设，宛如蜘蛛网撕裂破防。
对这个数次守护前世的娜娜公主，帝子云真的没脾气。他一旦承认对方身份，一般都像宠溺芸姬妹妹一般，就像灵汐宝，随时随地都可以给他准备铁钉搓衣板，他依旧疼爱灵汐如当初。
宠妹狂的帝子云实际也是宠妻狂，他可以为了红颜杀神成魔。只见他不顾琵琶神将的万古诅咒杀伐攻击其身，光芒大盛间，他指诀飞掐形成一个雷电时空法力囚笼，覆盖包裹娜娜公主直接飞向主战舰。
而法力囚笼不但保护娜娜公主，且在飞速修复娜娜公主被攻击的万古诅咒创伤。主战舰上的神兵看着云帝的法力囚笼包裹着帝子妃飞来，顷刻便飞向前去保护。
殊不知帝子云的法力囚笼被呼延娜娜硬生生改变方向，如电如光飞向天界神兵神将一刹那引爆最强神战。帝国御林军统领见状；“快快快，全力保护营救帝子妃。”
帝子妃乃龙汉后宫之主象征，这要出任何意外，后果不堪设想。有了帝子云的法力囚笼保护，呼延娜娜公主只攻不防，战力急剧飙升。
天兵天将与龙汉帝国神兵勇士霎那间在云巅之上杀作一团，无法实施远程大范围攻击。神战神光神域近身格斗激烈碰撞，杀得这方天域不稳撕裂波动，带着毁灭。这是离古玄世界最近最强神战爆发。
高空的龙汉之子云帝勇斗琵琶神将，帝子妃亲身神战让冰雪大陆万族久违的热血点燃，前赴后继勇猛反扑魔神军魔物魔兽逆神天庭伪神。
尽管许多万族法力浅薄，以战止战皆是飞蛾扑火，但，挡不住他们与黑暗魔爪一决生死之心。而一些伪神境以上万族勇士利用飞行灵宝腾空而起加入天空神战，他们无惧一切，即使只能吸引分散消耗逆神一丝火力，就死得其所。
但神战开启，神级以下皆是蝼蚁，神战波动的法力，以及神光神域碰撞发出的逆光爆炸冲击波，就让神级以下神战
千里之外焚为飞烟，簌簌簌的如雨点般坠落天空。
即使如此毁灭，也挡不住激起保卫星球的武修们前赴后继，甚至化境元境都祭出飞行灵兵一飞冲天，争先恐后与逆神同归于尽。
万族勇士死的荡气回肠，英勇就义轰轰烈烈。然，作为瑾天帝时代公认的瑾天帝后，如今的云阳帝妃，正在与逆神奋勇厮杀的娜娜公主不能眼睁睁看着万族子民枉死；

“圣斗士殿主何在？立刻把赶来的万族勇士挡住，神级以下，统统收归舰队成为帝国战兵。伪神境以下禁止升天参加神战，岂能枉死卿卿性命。”
“遵命！”。司马相儒立刻安排执法令兵阻止万族武修盲目升空，把伪神境以上统一收归联合舰队，发放龙汉帝国武修军备用统一制式装备。
龙汉帝国统一制式装备可增强防御力与攻击力，特别是融合了帝子云带来的高科改进后，制式装备更是提升综合战力值。
如此众多的武修军加入，辅助舰队伐神法力光球辅助。前有帝子云力抗琵琶古神，有娜娜公主以及其他神级力战牵制逆神天兵天将，有龙汉帝国神兵联合舰队大力辅助。
本土作战，占据天时地利人和，离古玄世界最近最强神战天平在向光明正义倾斜，一度占据上风。然，琵琶神将却打的窝囊，万古以来他感受到从来不曾有过的耻辱。
自成为天界神将以来，收割万界那一次不是手到擒来，旗开得胜。这次居然对上由一个小年轻率领的舰队打的丢盔弃甲，节节败退。
琵琶神将心有不甘，被帝子云那个人形怪物压着打。数枚枇杷膏服下，创伤修复战力急剧飙升，对着帝子云便发起它的最强琵琶金刚镇三界。
“所谓古神也不过尔尔，在绝对实力面前，统统皆是渣。混元剑罡，灭！”。很快适应古神神通法术攻击的帝子云宛如傲立九幽伟岸天神，一剑劈出他独有的多彩之光法力光球。
所谓的剑法，剑道名字，只是一个代号而已。重要的是所拥有的综合战力值以及各种属性法力精纯累积，外加意志力和自身本体的强悍。故，帝子云所有师尊皆对他的本体大力磨炼改造，没有例外。
故，看上去帝子云阶位与琵琶古神相去甚远，然，他年轻气盛带着血气方刚与不灭战意，一剑斩下让仙神都惊艳的神剑。他的每一剑如今都是货真价实神剑，不仅仅是以前叫的神剑以提神提气。
他的修炼体系繁复，因他的属性太多，几乎涵盖宇宙所有属性，故，剑气如同多彩之光，剑芒如虹宛如惊鸿，剑气如同巨浪滔天，以势不可挡滚滚向前。仿佛九色彩虹连天，在天空如同超级焰火绽放，美轮美奂。
然，越是美丽，越是有毒杀伤力巨大，杀戮毁灭方才是剑道本质内涵。琵琶神将以为那耀眼的多彩之光剑浪乃花把式，结果彩虹剑浪瞬间到达，剑浪宛如毁灭风暴一刹那将它包围，淹没。
然，琵琶神将发现遇上对红星，这个人形怪物的剑道不仅仅是一剑。乃飘凌水中花剑浪，无处不在，一浪更比一浪强，
不死不灭，直到把尔拍翻在云巅之上，绞碎，蹂躏，毁灭···
content_en:
The divine light flashed in the dark gray sky covered with war clouds, and the lean and lean Monkey Basihu Pipa General, dressed in a shining silver armor, fully loaded with divine defenses,
He found that he had been ignored because of the arrival of the goddess in green gauze and green clothes who was as beautiful as a fairy.
This is a naked contempt for its ancient gods and generals [This ancient god is not ancient, but an ancient god from the time of Emperor Jintian, that is, an ancient god millions of years ago. He is the clone descendant of the real ancient god Pipa】
Seeing two lowly species from the lower world [Pipa God General is jealous of the handsome and beautiful God] talking and laughing in front of him at the moment of life and death in the battle between Gods, completely ignoring this superior God,
The God of Pipa attacks the heart with fierce fire and strikes first. He picks up his lute and plucks the strings, emitting the most powerful everlasting curse, the most poisonous, soul-collecting and soul-devouring sound wave; "Pipa King Kong suppresses the three realms, die!"
As soon as the ancient god Pipa takes action, he knows how to play the piano randomly. The descendants of the loquat tree from the prehistoric period are not formidable. The sound wave carries an eternal curse and kills like thousands of souls killing flying arrows. The sound wave sweeps across the dark sky in an instant.
How can he be a mediocre person if he can be named the God-defying Heavenly Heavenly Soldier and God-General? The super divine magic power made the imperial warriors unable to resist in an instant. And God General Pipa's curse attack was mainly aimed at Di Ziyun. As the saying goes, to capture the thief first, capture the king.
Even though Princess Huyan Nana opened the divine realm of divine light, she was penetrated by the eternal curse sound wave of Pipa God General. She only felt that her soul was unstable and her heart was being eaten by thousands of ants. Invincibility within the divine realm is only a relative term. Once the opponent's level of magical power exceeds too many, it will be in vain, just like a spider web tearing through the defense.
Di Ziyun really had no temper for Princess Nana, who had protected her in her previous life several times. Once he admits the identity of the other party, he usually dotes on Yunji's sister, just like Lingxi Bao, who can prepare a nail washboard for him anytime and anywhere. He still loves Lingxi as before.
Di Ziyun, who is crazy about doting on his younger sister, is actually also crazy about doting on his wife. He can kill gods and become demons just for his beauty. I saw that he ignored the eternal curse of Pipa God General and attacked him. When the light was shining, he flew with his fingers to form a lightning time and space mana cage, covering Princess Nana and flying directly to the main battleship.
The mana cage not only protects Princess Nana, but also quickly repairs the eternal curse wound caused by Princess Nana's attack. The magic soldiers on the main battleship watched Emperor Yun's magic cage flying towards the emperor's concubine, and immediately flew forward to protect her.
Little did he know that Di Ziyun's magic cage was abruptly changed by Huyan Nana, and flew towards the heavenly realm like lightning, divine weapons and generals, and instantly detonated the strongest divine battle. The commander of the Imperial Guards saw this and said, "Quick, quick, do your best to protect and rescue the emperor's concubine."
The emperor's concubine is the symbol of the master of Longhan's harem. If anything goes wrong, the consequences will be disastrous. With the protection of Di Ziyun's magic cage, Princess Huyan Nana could only attack but not defend, and her combat power soared sharply.
The Heavenly Soldiers and Heavenly Generals and the Longhan Empire's Divine Soldiers and Warriors suddenly joined forces on top of the clouds, unable to carry out long-range and large-scale attacks. The close combat between the gods and the gods of divine light collided fiercely, causing the sky to become unstable, tearing apart and causing waves and destruction. This is the most powerful divine war breaking out in the ancient mysterious world.
The high-altitude Long Han's son Yun Di fought bravely against the Pipa god general, and the emperor's concubine's personal divine battle ignited the long-lost passion of all the peoples in the Ice and Snow Continent, and they fought back bravely against the demon army, monsters, monsters, and the false gods in heaven.
Although many tribes have little magic power, and fighting to end wars is like moths flying into flames, this cannot stop them from fighting the claws of darkness for life and death. And some warriors of ten thousand races above the pseudo-god realm use flying spirit treasures to rise into the sky to join the battle of the gods in the sky. They are not afraid of anything. Even if they can only attract and consume a trace of the firepower of the anti-god, they will die a worthy death.
But when the divine war begins, everyone below the god level is ants. The fluctuating mana of the divine war, as well as the backlight explosion shock wave emitted by the collision of the divine light and divine realm, make the divine war below the god level impossible.
Thousands of miles away, it burned into flying smoke, falling into the sky like raindrops.
Even if it is so destroyed, it cannot stop the martial arts cultivators who are inspiring to defend the planet from continuing to fight, and even transform into realm elements.Jingdu launched flying spiritual soldiers and flew into the sky, scrambling to die with Nishen.
The death of the warriors of all races was heart-wrenching, and their heroic sacrifice was vigorous and vigorous. However, as the recognized empress of Emperor Jintian in the era of Emperor Jintian, Princess Nana, who is now Imperial Concubine Yunyang and is fighting bravely against Nishen, cannot just watch the people of all races die in vain;
"Where is the master of the Saint Seiya Hall? Immediately block the coming warriors of all races. All those below the god level will be gathered into the fleet and become imperial soldiers. Those below the pseudo-god level are prohibited from ascending to heaven to participate in the divine war. How can your life be wasted."
"Yes!". Sima Xiangru immediately arranged for law enforcement troops to prevent the martial arts cultivators of all races from blindly launching into the sky, brought the pseudo-god realm and above to the joint fleet, and issued unified standard equipment for the martial cultivators of the Longhan Empire.
The unified standard equipment of the Longhan Empire can enhance defense and attack power. Especially after incorporating the high-tech improvements brought by Di Ziyun, the standard equipment can increase the overall combat power value.
So many martial arts troops joined in, assisting the fleet with the God-defeating mana light ball. In front of them, Emperor Ziyun fought against the Ancient God Pipa, Princess Nana and other god-level warriors fought to contain the anti-god heavenly soldiers and generals, and the Longhan Empire's combined fleet of divine soldiers vigorously assisted.
Fighting locally, occupying the right time, place and people, the balance of the battle between the strongest gods closest to the ancient mysterious world is tilting towards light and justice, and once they had the upper hand. However, Pipa God was beaten to a coward, and he felt the humiliation he had never felt before in all eternity.
Since he became the God General of the Heavenly Realm, he has harvested all realms with ease and victory. This time, they actually faced a fleet led by a young man and lost all their armor. They were retreating steadily.
The Pipa God General was unwilling to be beaten by the humanoid monster Di Ziyun. After taking several pills of loquat ointment, the wound repair power surged sharply, and he launched his strongest Pipa King Kong to suppress the three realms against Di Ziyun.
"The so-called ancient gods are just mediocre. In the face of absolute strength, they are all scum. Hunyuan Sword Gang, destroyed!" Di Ziyun, who quickly adapted to the magical attacks of the ancient gods, was like a proud and majestic god standing proudly in the Nine Netherworld, slashing out his unique colorful light mana light ball with one sword.
The so-called swordsmanship, the name of swordsmanship is just a code name. What is important is the comprehensive combat power value and the pure accumulation of various attribute mana, plus willpower and the strength of one's own body. Therefore, all the masters of Di Ziyun vigorously trained and transformed his body, without exception.
Therefore, it seems that Di Ziyun's rank is far from that of the ancient god Pipa. However, he is young and energetic, full of vigor and undying fighting spirit, and he can kill the divine sword with one sword that astonishes even the immortals and gods. Each of his swords are now genuine divine swords, not just the divine swords they used to call to refresh their spirits.
His cultivation system is complicated, because he has too many attributes, covering almost all attributes in the universe. Therefore, the sword energy is like a colorful light, the sword light is like a rainbow, and the sword energy is like a huge wave rolling into the sky, rolling forward unstoppably. It's like a nine-color rainbow stretching into the sky, blooming like super fireworks in the sky, so beautiful.
However, the more beautiful it is, the more poisonous and destructive it is. Killing and destruction is the essence of kendo. The God of Pipa thought that the dazzling colorful light sword wave was just a trick, but the rainbow sword wave arrived instantly, and the sword wave surrounded and submerged it like a destructive storm in an instant.
However, Pipa God will find that when he encounters the red star, this humanoid monster's sword skills are more than just a sword. There are waves of swords floating in the water, everywhere, each wave is stronger than the other.
Immortal and immortal, until I am knocked over on top of the clouds, minced, ravaged, and destroyed...
